title: US consumer credit cards: earn rules, fees, credits (TrojanHacks finance data foundation)
schema_notes: multiplier = points per dollar, or percent cash back for cash cards (3% = 3). Value per dollar = multiplier * point_value_cents / 100.
earn_rules[].category uses only category_vocabulary. A purchase takes the best matching rule whose conditions hold; otherwise base_multiplier.

merchants (optional): when present, the rule applies ONLY at those merchants (e.g. Apple Card 3% at Uber, Exxon, Walgreens with Apple Pay; Sapphire Preferred 5x on Lyft). Match on the transaction merchant_name before falling back to the category rules.

cap: {amount (dollars of spend), period}; after the cap the rule earns after_cap_multiplier (default base_multiplier). A cap shared by several rules is described in conditions and, where present, a shared_cap_group key.
choice_group (optional): rules sharing a choice_group are pick-one (e.g. BofA Customized Cash 3% choice, Bilt Obsidian dining-or-grocery). The user picks one; the others don't apply.
rotating.q4_2026 lists vocabulary categories for Oct-Dec 2026; q4_2026_labels (when present) gives the issuer's own wording, including categories with no vocabulary match.
credits: amount is dollars per period; how_to_use says whether it is a statement credit, a discount or a free subscription.

point_value_cents: The Points Guy October 2026 valuations unless a card says otherwise. Freedom, Double Cash and Custom Cash are recorded as cash at 1.0; their points are worth the transferable value only when pooled with a premium card in the same program (see notes).
unverified: true means at least one field could not be confirmed on an issuer page on 2026-10-17; unverified_fields says which and notes names the secondary source.
travel_portal is the issuer's own portal (Chase Travel, Amex Travel, Capital One Travel, Citi Travel, Bilt Travel); merchants/conditions name it.
base_multiplier 0 means the card earns no rewards (Capital One Platinum Secured).

point_valuations.source: The Points Guy, October 2026 monthly valuations (cents per point)
point_valuations.notes: TPG's October 2026 page (dated 1 Oct 2026) does not value U.S. Bank, Bank of America or Discover points; treat those as fixed-value cash (1.0). Airline values marked * on TPG use Points Path data, hotel values ** use Gondola data.

nerdwallet.method: median real-world redemption value; 'baseline' is the cash/fixed value, 'value' is NerdWallet's estimate via the named best transfer partner
nerdwallet.notes: NerdWallet's UR value depends on the card because Chase moved non-Reserve cards to a 4:3 Hyatt transfer ratio in 2026; Sapphire Reserve keeps 1:1. U.S. Bank not listed.

rotating.detail: 5% on up to $1,500 of combined purchases in the quarter's categories (up to $75), then 1%. Must activate each quarter (app, online, phone); 5% starts on the later of Oct 1 or the activation date, not retroactive. Restaurants: full-service, cafes, cafeterias, fast food, caterers (restaurants inside other businesses and bakeries may not count). Utilities: residential electric, gas, water, plus internet, cable, satellite TV and phone bills paid online or by phone; excludes bills paid in store, through a landlord/HOA, home fuel delivery, standalone streaming. 'utilities' and 'phone' overlap: phone bills count here this quarter.

signup_bonus.detail: Cashback Match: all cash back earned in the first 365 days from approval is matched dollar for dollar, unlimited, added within two billing periods after year one; no minimum spend. Per Doctor of Credit (14 Oct 2026) the match now includes Capital One Offers rewards. Effectively doubles every first-year rate (10% on Q4 categories, 2% base).

earn_rules.conditions: Bilt Housing Payments (rent, mortgage, HOA etc.) paid through the Bilt app/site, no fee. Default 'Housing-only Option': multiplier set each billing cycle by everyday spend as a share of the housing payment: >=25% -> 0.5X, >=50% -> 0.75X, >=75% -> 1X, >=100% -> 1.25X; below 25% a flat 250 points per cycle. 1.25X is the maximum, not the default. No transaction-count requirement. 1X at ordinary restaurants; Bilt Neighborhood Dining partner restaurants (20,000+) add a per-restaurant bonus shown in the app, 'up to 4X' total per bilt.com

cards.notes: Bilt 2.0 (launched 7 Feb 2026) replaced the Wells Fargo-issued Bilt Mastercard: three cards (Blue $0, Obsidian $95, Palladium $495) issued by Column N.A., serviced by Cardless; Bilt Card Offer Terms last updated 18 Sept 2026. The old 'use the card 5 times per statement' rule is gone. Rewards option: Housing-only (default; earns no Bilt Cash on everyday spend) or Flexible Bilt Cash (4% Bilt Cash on all everyday spend, excluding housing). Pick within 7 days of opening; later changes apply from the next billing cycle. Under Flexible, unlocking 1X on a $2,000 rent takes $60 of Bilt Cash, i.e. $1,500 of everyday spend. Bilt Cash expires 31 Dec each year; up to $100 carries over. It is also redeemable for Lyft, Bilt Travel hotels, Grubhub, Walgreens, SoulCycle, GoPuff and others (merchant caps), transfer bonuses and status. Rent Day promo (1 Mar 2026 to 1 Jan 2027): on the 1st of each month Blue earns 2X on non-housing purchases, max 1,000 bonus points per month. Points transfer 1:1 to airline and hotel partners and can pay rent, mortgage, student loans or a statement credit (min 1,000 pts; value set by Bilt). APR: 10% intro APR on new purchases for 12 billing cycles, then 26.74%-34.74% variable (one range for all three cards on bilt.com). No foreign transaction fee. Cell phone protection, purchase assurance, MasterRental CDW. Welcome bonus: $100 Bilt Cash on opening, only if you have never held a Bilt 2.0 card.
